text: I wish there was something exciting around here to get<65534>my blood pumping, my heart pounding...<65535>
Something like...<65535>
She is looking... right at me!<65535>
Now that you are done, farewell. We must be off.<65535>
Wait! Don't go!<65535>
A man must protect the woman that he loves... at all<65534>costs! That's it! I'm going with you!<65535>
Going with us...?<65535>
Listen. We are on our way to form alliances with other<65534>forces. We cannot afford any delays.<65535>
I'll be quick as a fox! <65535>
Just wait here one moment! Let me go get ready!<65535>
Will you really let him come with us?<65535>
Hmph. Look at him running. Do you honestly believe he<65534>could be In love?<65535>

The answer is in his eyes. He has himself convinced he<65534>is in love, but truth be told, he is using it as an<65534>excuse to run away from something.<65530><557><65533>He has merely replaced his fear with desire.<65535>
He's jumping out of the frying pan, into the fire,<65534>running from one problem to the next.<65535>
What now, Boss?  What are your orders?<65535>
Just... leave him be. Despite the fact he is trapped by<65534>his fears, he is still free to choose even if his<65534>choices are selfish.<65535>
You're not hurt, are you!? No... No... No... Great!<65534>You're all right!<65535>
Eh... You know, it is good that you are good! <65535>
So, this... is... nice weather today! You know it is an<65534>honor, to protect you!<65535>
What... Hold on! Where are you going now?<65535>
If you must know, to the next battlefield.<65535>
I'll escort you!<65535>
Just go home.<65535>
Don't be like that. I'm here to protect you! What would<65534>you do without me!?<65535>
I'd have one less person to worry about, for starters.<65535>
That's not true! Ahhh, I can take care of myself.<65535>
I am over here! Toshiie!<65535>
You're all right...!<65535>
I was so afraid... I thought I would never see you<65534>again.<65535>
Thank you for helping us.<65535>
You didn't need me. You were the one who saved her,<65534>Keiji.<65535>
Magoichi, allow me to thank you properly...<65535>
You don't need to thank me. I'm just glad to know<65534>you're safe. Everyone is.<65535>
Of course...<65535>
I feel a bit light-headed... I don't think I've eaten<65534>since Matsu was kidnapped...<65535>
Oh dear! Let's go home so I can cook some food! You are<65534>welcome to join us.<65535>
I'm afraid I must be on my way. So, 'til next time.<65535>
Magoichi!<65535>
I'm going home with them, but only for now. Once they<65534>have settled, I will come find you... I'll see you<65534>again.<65535>
Right... Let's go.<65535>
I did as you asked. I left the Western Army...<65535>
All right, then. Now that that's done, you mentioned<65534>something about having a favor you wished to ask<65534>Ieyasu?<65535>
I beg of you! Yoshiaki! Please ask Ieyasu to free<65534>Matsu! In return, I will serve the Eastern Army, and<65534>obey their every bid!<65535>
Hmph. I think it's a little late for favors.<65535>
Huh!? Wh-- How-- Magoichi!?<65535>
Look no further, Keiji. The man responsible for<65534>kidnapping Matsu... is this Weasel.<65535>
It was part of an elaborate plan to get close to<65534>Ieyasu. And it almost worked.<65535>
Where did they go!? Where is the coward that had the<65534>nerve to attack me from behind!?<65535>
So it was you... You kidnapped Matsu!!<65535>
I-- I did no such thing!<65535>
There's no use in pretending anymore. We have uncovered<65534>your true motives.<65535>
If what you say is actually true, then I'm afraid<65534>you've left me no choice. I must defeat the both of<65534>you!<65535>
It's been grand, but I'm afraid I really must be off!<65535>
Not that I'm not grateful, but why are you here?<65535>
I left the Western Army behind, and I shall never again<65534>be able to return.<65535>
Wha-- Really...?! You did that for me?!<65535>
Don't flatter yourself. Our contract simply expired. I<65534>have come here in hopes of finding a new one, but no<65534>luck so far.<65535>
All right... Well then, I guess there's only one thing<65534>left to sort out.<65535>

Ieyasu... and the Dark King! The time has finally come<65534>to put an end to their battle! Their ridiculous rivalry<65534>has split the entire country in two!<65530><928><65533>I will not tolerate it anymore!<65535>
If you intend to stop them, then allow us to assist<65534>you.<65535>
I'd be honored...!<65535>
Wait! Cease this madness!<65535>
Now, really, both of you, that is enough. I think it's<65534>time to put this feud to rest. No good can come from<65534>this squabbling.<65535>
Keiji, have you lost your mind!?<65535>
Leave now! Unless you wish to die with Ieyasu!<65535>
There must be some way I can convince you to stop...<65534>Hah!<65535>
Boy, you just signed your death warrant...! Prepare<65534>yourself!<65535>
You leave me no choice... but to fight.<65535>
Wow. Really? Still won't give up? Well then, don't say<65534>I didn't warn you! You see, I have grown incredibly<65534>strong of late! <65535>
Mark my words... I swear that I will defeat you both<65534>and end this war!<65535>
That should keep the two of them quiet for a while. And<65534>with them out of the way, maybe, we'll finally have<65534>some peace around here.<65535>
Magoichi, I thought that... I would never see you<65534>again, or at least... only in my dreams. But then you<65534>came, and I couldn't believe my eyes! I'm grateful.<65535>
It was not by choice. I came because I was contracted<65534>to do so. Don't you remember our agreement? Did you not<65534>ask us for our help?<65535>
What!? Ahh... A contract? Oh, I--I thought--! Wow!<65534>That's embarrassing! You know I... don't even remember<65534>that! Did I really say... I would pay you!?<65535>
We kept our end of the deal, don't tell me you can't<65534>keep yours.<65535>
Well maybe we can... work something out!?<65535>
Perhaps we could...<65535>
How about... you devote your life to the Saica<65534>Faction...? You'll work for us, fight for us, and die<65534>in our name.<65535>
Eh... Yes! I would love to! I would be honored to serve<65534>you, Magoichi!<65535>
Hmph... So we have a deal.<65535>
I wish... I knew what he was thinking before he died.<65534>But now, it's too late. I can't... I'll never know...<65534>And there's nothing I can do.<65535>

I have fought many battles and seen many men die. I,<65534>myself, have lost more friends than I would like to<65534>count.<65530><650><65533>With that said, when I take a look back on my<65534>life, I feel nothing at all, just, emptiness.<65535>
The only thing that could comfort me, throughout all<65534>these years, is knowing that I have lived my life<65534>following my own beliefs...<65535>
If I have learned one thing so far, it is that death is<65534>inevitable. Life is tough. It's tawdry, but it's true.<65535>
I suppose...<65535>
If there is something that you wish to know, then seek<65534>out the answer... and then let it bother your mind no<65534>more.<65535>

I did not realize it, but what I sought was always<65534>before me... Hmph.  I have waited long for this day...<65534>to finally have the answer I was searching for.<65530><1055><65533>I apologize... for having worried you.<65535>
Are you leaving...?<65535>

Yes. I must go and speak to Ieyasu. Maybe, he can<65534>explain to me his actions. He must know what Hideyoshi<65534>was thinking in his final moments.<65530><723><65533>It is now time, at long last, that I learned the truth.<65535>
Right. I'll have your place set at the table... and<65534>your dinner waiting, just the way you like it.<65535>
Thanks. I'll return soon.<65535>
Tell me, Ieyasu... I must know the truth. His last<65534>words... What did he say?<65535>
He said... "What do you think we should do next,<65534>Hanbe?" Then he was gone.<65535>
He mentioned... Hanbe...?<65535>
So... how did he say it?<65535>
As if remembering better times he... said it with a<65534>smile.<65535>
Did he show... any hesitation?<65535>
What about regret?<65535>
Never. He honored his beliefs right up until the end...<65534>and not once did he doubt them or waver.<65535>
He lived a fine life. And his deeds, for good or ill,<65534>will never be forgotten...<65535>
It was a great dream... my dear friend... It truly was.<65535>
Both of you! Stop right there!<65535>
You have proven how strong you truly are. It is a<65534>wondrous thing to behold.<65535>
Oh! Why thank you!<65535>
You say that you seek justice. If you will, I ask that<65534>you please share your vision with us.<65535>
Why of course! I'd be happy to!<65535>
Such generosity.<65535>
I beg your pardon for being so bold. But I need help<65534>unifying the West.<65535>
Is that all you ask? Then don't worry. Since it's a<65534>very honorable task. I'll do my best!<65535>
Yes... It is honorable. It is honorable indeed.<65535>
With respect, let me offer you some words of wisdom. Be<65534>careful. You must be prepared for anything to happen.<65535>
Wait. What do you mean by that?<65535>
Those who can be lured by a silver tongue are no more<65534>than fools. Little Crane, make sure you are not one of<65534>them.<65535>
Where has everyone gone? There is no one left... I am<65534>all alone...alone...all alone...<65535>
Are you here all by yourself? The others...did<65534>everybody die?<65535>
There is no one here...<65535>
I understand now. You're alone like me.<65535>
Don't worry. I'm going to stay with you from now on.<65534>That way you will not be lonely.<65535>
Please tell me the truth Motonari!  I do not know what<65534>to think. It's just that...<65535>
I've had enough!<65535>
Yoshitsugu requested that we meet... but I can no<65534>longer tolerate your drivel.<65535>
Uh... What do you mean by that?<65535>
Had I the patience. I would have manipulated you and<65534>used you to my advantage. However, I do not. You are<65534>intolerable and I find your presence most vexing.<65535>
Does that mean...that I have been deceived?<65535>
I will never ever forgive you!<65535>
Say no more! The man you seek...<65535>
Is this ninja, is he not?<65535>
It's him!<65535>
He is a ninja that they call "legend," and he's<65534>currently an ally of the Eastern Army.<65535>
I've been searching so long...so very long!<65535>

Those deep impenetrable eyes... Your saintly figure. <65534>There can be no mistake.  You are my Twilight Ninja!<65530><716><65533>Wherever you are, wherever you go I will follow you<65534>unto the ends of the world. <65535>

We have a score to settle! How dare you deceive me! You<65534>should know that I am no longer afraid of anything.<65530><456><65533>At least, not now that I have my Twilight Ninja by my<65534>side!<65535>
I do not know whom it is you are speaking of, but I do<65534>know you were a fool to trust me.<65535>
My ninja has summoned the powers of the winds to save<65534>me three times. And this next time...will be his<65534>fourth.<65535>
I knew this would happen. I knew that you would swoop<65534>in to protect me. Oh my Twilight Ninja. Thank you. I am<65534>yours!<65535>
What the... Wait! Twilight Ninja! Please wont you come<65534>back!<65535>
Oh! That's right!  What about his name? Come back! You<65534>still haven't told me your name!<65535>
I have beaten you at your silly game. Which means you<65534>and your men must sail away on your boat.<65535>
Oh really? How dare you speak that way to me! You are a<65534>rude and insolent brat...!<65535>
How dare you! I am nothing of the sort.  I'll have you<65534>know that I am a sweet and demure young lady!<65535>
As if I care! Let us fight. And I will silence that<65534>tongue of yours!<65535>
As you wish! I am ready for you anytime!  I will defeat<65534>you with one arrow!<65535>
I have beaten you again... Take your men...and get out!<65535>
Have you been watching me? My Twilight Ninja? Did you<65534>see? I did my best!<65535>
It's terrible! The pirates have completely taken over<65534>my hometown!<65535>
Attention Motochika's Pirates. Listen to what I have to<65534>say. Go home right now!<65535>
Well, what do you think? It's my brand new weapon.<65534>Quite impressive, isn't it? And it's more impressive<65534>when you see it in action.<65535>
You mean that thing? It's so lame! I mean who commits<65534>crimes with a toy fish hook?<65535>
What? A toy fish hook? Any fool can tell it is nothing<65534>of the sort. Its greatness is wasted on the likes of<65534>you...<65535>
I don't care how great you think it is. Take your<65534>pirates and your rubbish...<65535>
...and get out!<65535>
Damn you, Tsuruhime. This isn't over yet. I will defeat<65534>you!<65535>
Yeah, you better run!  And don't come back!<65535>
I should've demanded that they clean up before I made<65534>them leave.<65535>
Ah... What is this? For me?<65535>
An alliance? You should have said so earlier! I<65534>actually thought I was about to meet my death!<65534>Seriously... You certainly gave me a good scare!<65535>
This proposal, I accept. It would be an honor to have<65534>you join me. A ninja in my army... Inform your Lord, of<65534>my decision.<65535>
Oh my! Is it really you? Are you my savior? The one<65534>from that day? You...You've saved my life so many<65534>times!<65535>
I'm so happy! You've come all this way, just to see me!<65535>
This is fate! The dark feathers soar through the breeze<65534>as destiny arrives! Thou art him! My heavenly<65534>messenger!My angel!<65535>
Well done, Kotaro! Well done! Well done!<65535>
It has been too long...<65535>
I've been waiting all this time... Waiting...for the<65534>day we would meet again. There is no need for you to<65534>say a word. I understand... I understand how you feel!<65535>
My Twilight Ninja!<65535>
Ujimasa... Why?!<65535>
What is this? Could it be... medicine...?<65535>
Young Tiger... Would you please give this to him for<65534>me?<65535>
I am so grateful... Ujimasa....<65535>
So be it... For now we set aside our quarrel. I<65534>admit...I cannot hope to best Ieyasu yet.<65535>
Damn it all! Curse this weakness! <65535>
A piece of advise, if I may be so bold...<65535>
Be wise. Replenish your broken forces...and forge an<65534>alliance with Mitsunari post haste.<65535>
Pledge my fealty to the Dark King himself?<65535>
Only Mitsunari and Kenshin are strong enough.  The rest<65534>are but dry leaves beneath his feet.<65535>
Kenshin? I doubt he would sully himself with an ally<65534>such as me. <65535>

True, he may be too big of a fish to net.  But<65534>Mitsunari  detests Ieyasu.  From varied motivations may<65534>be born a victory.<65530><782><65533>Do you understand...or does pride obscureth all?<65535>
How clever you are, Motonari. How wondrously sly.<65535>
I will adopt your plan Motonari... but know, that I<65534>offer you neither friendship nor quarter. After Ieyasu<65534>has paid for his misdeeds...<65535>
I will end you.<65535>
Very well.    <65535>
Do try not to die...   I'd hate to miss your plans for<65534>me.<65535>
If you wish to kill Ieyasu, we share this goal in<65534>common.<65535>
I wish only vengeance for slaughtered friends! Ieyasu<65534>has strayed from the path of the righteous, and with<65534>this betrayal, his life is forfeit!<65535>
He is no longer the man I knew...! I cannot suffer him<65534>to live!<65535>
Your bleeding heart, concerns me not in the least,<65534>Motochika. That said, to destroy Ieyasu, I will ally<65534>with you!<65535>
But if you think for even a moment that I'll allow you<65534>the honor of taking his life, you're sorely mistaken!<65535>
I knew you would say such a thing. Allow me to show<65534>you...how keenly I wish to split the villain asunder!<65535>
You have suffered much... I know of such pain. My<65534>sympathies...your anguish is a barb in your soul... <65535>
Silence! Do not presume to know my pain...!<65535>
We're two sides of the same coin, you and I. I hereby<65534>join the Western Army. <65535>
Join me or don't... I care not. But know...once you<65534>swear your fealty to me, any betrayal is death!<65535>
Well, you've my word... and I will never dishonor<65534>myself.<65535>
Swear upon your soul...!<65535>
Upon my soul.<65535>
Huh...? What is it?<65535>
A long time ago... I fought with a man and had the bout<65534>end much in the manner of this one...<65535>
Our world has changed much since then...<65535>
Spare me your puerile ramblings. I don't give a damn.<65535>
Behold Ieyasu, uniter of the land! Such was his<65534>aspiration, at least... or perhaps that was never more<65534>than a mere chantey he warbled to the Sea Devil.<65535>
Why did you attack Shikoku? How do you justify such<65534>cowardice?!<65535>
I did no such thing.<65535>
Do you think me a fool?! Your banner smiled upon the<65534>carnage!<65535>
My banner... but how...?!<65535>
Silence! I even wrote to you in good faith... only to<65534>lose my messenger to one of your bloodthirsty curs!<65535>
I understand. This betrayal tears at your heart. You<65534>despise me, don't you?<65535>
Damn you! I have come to drink deep from the font of<65534>vengeance!<65535>
Very well. Nothing I can say will sate your thirst.<65535>
If you must enact such vengeance, then I will bear that<65534>burden.<65535>
I call upon the Sea Devil! The peerless Captain,<65534>Motochika...!<65535>
I, Ieyasu Tokugawa, will brave your fatal tempest!<65535>
Motochika... are you satisfied...?<65535>
Join my murdered men...! I have slain you on their<65534>behalf!<65535>
I shall...gladly, friend...<65535>

Motochika... be careful, for hatred can blind you.<65534>Don't let...your emotions take hold of the wheel, and<65534>steer you into the rocks.<65530><840><65533>The Motochika I know is an honorable man who keeps...<65534>one eye on the horizon...<65535>
Motochika... remember the days before this. As a<65534>friend, I beg of you... please, remember...<65535>
You know, Sayaka...<65535>
You are going to help me. It's as simple as that. By<65534>aid of your weaponry, I shall take my revenge!<65535>
Motochika...?<65535>
God, you're thickheaded.<65535>
Don't do that!<65535>
Are you quite done with your little tantrum?  Before<65534>you go charging in...my guns a-blazing...perhaps you<65534>should give thinking a try.<65535>
Fine!  What do you want me think about?!<65535>
Your present ignorance. Gather information, for it<65534>shall empower you.<65535>
Aye, as you've preached to me many a time.<65535>
I'll ferret out what truths I can. As for you... well,<65534>proceed North. Head to Masamune. I'm sure he'll give<65534>you a warm welcome.<65535>
Aye...understood.<65535>
I swear, Motochika. I wouldn't behave so poorly.<65535>
Ieyasu, do you give me your solemn word?<65535>
I swear to you upon our friendship, which I hold as<65534>precious. Will that do?<65535>
I've been a fool. How could I have doubted you?<65535>
Then who...<65535>
Don't know...<65535>
I didn't miss all the fun, did I?<65535>
Sayaka!<65535>
Magoichi?<65535>
I come bearing truth.<65535>
And I'm glad to see you in one piece, Ieyasu. This<65534>one's more dangerous than you'd assume... and he<65534>doesn't have much of a fuse.<65535>
I have fuse aplenty!  Go ahead!<65535>
I'll get right to it, then. The man who attacked<65534>Shikoku was Kanbe Kuroda.<65535>
It was Kanbe...Kuroda...?<65535>
Die, villain!<65535>
Damn it!    <65535>
I am undone!<65535>
Ieyasu!<65535>
I know you're gonna cut me to ribbons no matter what I<65534>say. Still wanna hear my reasons?<65535>
Spare me your excuses!  My slaughtered men can never be<65534>explained away!<65535>
No, I figured not. It's too bad. If only I'd had enough<65534>spine to stand up to Mitsunari, one of us wouldn't have<65534>to die today.<65535>
I'm through lying about this evil things I've done. I'm<65534>tired of feeling like this... like my soul's been<65534>rotting away...<65535>
Still... I am not about to kill myself, so you've got a<65534>fight on your hands. <65535>
I will have my revenge...and send you straight to hell!<65535>
Rest, me hearties...today you are avenged...<65535>
Oh Captain...!<65535>
We avenged 'em, Captain, blood for blood...<65535>
O stalwarts...who is our most loyal friend in this<65534>world?<65535>
Ieyasu, Captain...!<65535>
I swear, Motochika. I wouldn't behave so poorly.<65535>
Ieyasu, do you give me your solemn word?<65535>
I swear to you upon our friendship, which I hold as<65534>precious. Will that do?<65535>
I've been a fool. How could I have doubted you?<65535>
Then who...<65535>
Don't know...<65535>
I didn't miss all the fun, did I?<65535>
Sayaka!<65535>
Magoichi?<65535>
I come bearing truth.<65535>
And I'm glad to see you in one piece, Ieyasu. This<65534>one's more dangerous than you'd assume... and he<65534>doesn't have much of a fuse.<65535>
I have fuse aplenty!  Go ahead!<65535>
The attack was just a ploy to manipulate you into<65534>fighting Ieyasu. Mark well the names of your true<65534>quarry: Mitsunari, Yoshitsugu, and Motonari.<65535>
Can...can this be the truth?! How deeply I've wronged<65534>you, Ieyasu...?! My comrades really died at the hands<65534>of...!<65535>
Nothing angers me more than those who practice<65534>betrayal...! Death is their reward for having<65534>dishonored my name!<65535>
Mitsunari...<65535>
I take full responsibility for their evil deeds. I knew<65534>not of them, but my ignorance is no excuse.<65535>
Do with me as you will. Strike me down if you think it<65534>just. I don't blame you.<65535>
You are nothing if not honorable... and you're honest,<65534>most likely to a fault. I'm starting to see why people<65534>aren't enamored of you.<65535>
Spare me your pointless chatter and kill me!<65535>
Looks like I missed my mark. <65535>
C'mon!  We've much to do!<65535>
What is the meaning of this?<65535>
You were willing to die for the misdeeds of another.<65534>Call me a fool, but I can't slay the righteous.<65535>
I don't understand...<65535>
Come along or stay behind... but live well. You owe my<65534>murdered brothers that much!<65535>
You know what I'm going to say, Motonari...<65535>
It's your own fault. You should more carefully screen<65534>your sources in the future.<65535>
You're right. I accept my part in this. However...<65535>
After I slay you here, I'll say it over the graves of<65534>my murdered crew. And into the ears of your masterless<65534>men.<65530><738><65533>It will be as though Motonari never existed. <65535>
I know it sounds foolish, but I couldn't have come to<65534>this moment without help from others. They showed me<65534>the error of my ways.<65535>
Such maudlin nonsense...!<65535>
They saved my soul.<65535>
I will never forget those who died, that day or this!<65534>And I know when I meet my end... I, too, will be<65534>remembered. You can make no such claim, Motonari!<65535>
What...do you mean...?<65535>

When all is said and done, what little did you achieve<65534>through your villainy?! You walk the path of a coward,<65534>creeping your way through the dark!<65530><543><65533>'Tis lonely...and that loneliness will follow you into<65534>death! Motonari Mori, may you suffer through eternity,<65534>with not a kindred soul to give you solace!<65535>
How dare you...?! You would not tolerate such<65534>insolence!<65535>
That took some doing...<65535>
Forgive me, Ieyasu! How could I have doubted your<65534>righteousness, my friend?! There's naught I wouldn't<65534>give to try and earn your pardon, even my life...! <65535>
Please, Motochika! There's nothing to forgive!<65535>
I must atone for having been such a fool!<65535>
So be it. Hmm... Well, let me think...<65535>
When I die someday, you are to remember me. How does<65534>that sound?<65535>
You idiot...!<65535>
I said "remember me when I die," not "hasten it<65534>along"...!<65535>
You never could take a punch...!<65535>
Come on... Let's go.<65535>
Are you going to visit their graves? May I join you?<65535>
Of course! I'm sure their spirits would be honored!<65535>
What flowers should we bring them?<65535>
We're bringing them sake... They were sailors, not<65534>monks.<65535>
It's not yet rained. Not with these stars that I see<65534>before me...<65535>
I hope and pray for a glorious death to descend from<65534>the heavens and take me from this world.<65530><404><65533>O divine stardust, bestow glory on me and grant me<65534>deliverance...!<65535>
Yoshitsugu.<65535>
Ah. Mitsunari.<65535>
Motonari is ready for battle... Let's go.<65535>
